[SWS_LinIf_00634] ⌈The function LinIf_SetTrcvMode is required only if at least
one LIN channel uses the LIN transceiver driver. This function shall be pre-compile time
configurable On/Off by the configuration parameter LinIfTrcvDriverSupported.⌋
Caveats: The LIN Interface has to be initialized with a call of LinIf_Init before this
API service may be called, see [SRS_BSW_00487].
